evidence_policy: Evidence classes remain distinct. Shared project ancestry is not independent replication. Synthetic proxy execution is not live FRANK evidence.

internal_evidence.detail: Current stage BASE_CLAYCODE_RELEASE; gate in progress.
Defines convergence/productive-cycle/stalled/diverging regimes and asks GWT to test adaptive compute routing.
GWT next test explicitly: fixed recurrence budget versus outcome-gated adaptive continue/exit routing with matched episodes.
Requires typed measurement receipts, counterfactual replay, receiver-stage distinctions, re-entry and cost shadows.
GWT is observability/intervention plane; control target is verified task gain under stability, authority, cost and recovery constraints, not emergence maximization.

Generic records/rules and GWT tensor exist; current GWT section does not expose loop identity, recurrence budget, halt/continue reasons, regime classification or measurement receipts as first-class GWT types.

external_primary_sources.title: Adaptive Computation Time for Recurrent Neural Networks
external_primary_sources.relevance: Establishes learned input-dependent recurrent computation depth and shows computation can be allocated according to problem difficulty.

external_primary_sources.title: PonderNet: Learning to Ponder
external_primary_sources.relevance: Adaptive number of computational steps under an explicit accuracy/computation trade-off; relevant analogue for recurrence-budget control.

external_primary_sources.title: Coordination Among Neural Modules Through a Shared Global Workspace
external_primary_sources.relevance: Demonstrates bandwidth-limited shared workspace with competition among specialist modules; supports using workspace capacity as a coordination bottleneck, not the proposed recurrence controller itself.

external_primary_sources.title: Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models
external_primary_sources.relevance: Shows context-sensitive compute allocation can improve compute efficiency at fixed aggregate budgets.

external_primary_sources.title: CoTFormer: A Chain of Thought Driven Architecture with Budget-Adaptive Computation Cost at Inference
external_primary_sources.relevance: Shows budget-adaptive variable-depth computation can reduce inference computation without reducing accuracy in the reported settings.

external_primary_sources.title: Reasoning with Latent Thoughts: On the Power of Looped Transformers
external_primary_sources.relevance: Supports the proposition that repeated/looped depth can implement iterative reasoning and that effective depth can matter independently of parameter count.

external_primary_sources.title: Adaptive Layer-skipping in Pre-trained LLMs
external_primary_sources.relevance: Reports variable compute demand across tokens but also that dynamic skipping did not automatically yield wall-clock speedup because routing/I/O overhead matters.

external_primary_sources.title: Universal Transformers Need Memory: Depth-State Trade-offs in Adaptive Recursive Reasoning
external_primary_sources.relevance: Reports a shallow-halt initialization trap for ACT-like routing and a memory-versus-ponder-depth trade-off; motivates explicit anti-shallow-halt probes and state/budget co-measurement.

external_primary_sources.title: The Recurrent Transformer: Greater Effective Depth and Efficient Decoding
external_primary_sources.relevance: Shows a recurrent transformer can trade recurrence/effective depth against architectural depth and memory/latency in reported experiments; relevant to loop-depth economics.

negative_and_limiting_evidence: Dynamic computation does not guarantee wall-clock speedup; routing/synchronization/I/O can dominate.
Adaptive halting can collapse into shallow-halt equilibria depending on initialization/calibration.
The current synthetic experiment authors the regime dynamics and therefore cannot establish transfer to FRANK.
Shared project directives and cross-branch feedback are one ancestry family and do not count as replication.
No current GWT room-state file was materialized at the expected repo-native path during this run; no same-room live worker evidence was assumed.
inference_boundary: External adaptive-computation results support feasibility of variable compute, not the specific claim that GWT focus is the correct recurrence-routing signal for FRANK. That linkage remains an OPEN inference requiring H1 intervention evidence.
